run_f_gold: run f_gold to count groups of size 2 or 3 with sum divisible by 3
test_f_gold: test f_gold against multiple parameter sets and print success count
review_f_gold: review f_gold algorithm that uses modulo-3 grouping to count valid combinations
summarize_f_gold: summarize f_gold which computes combinations of pairs and triplets with sum multiple of 3
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to use integer division instead of float division for combination counts
